rules.title: How to Play Fabble
rules.what_is_body: Fabble is a daily Flesh and Blood card guessing game. Pick a card, see how its attributes compare to the secret card, and use the clues to close in on the answer.
rules.making_a_guess_body: Type any real card name and submit it. Your guess is compared to the answer across 11 attributes, and each tile tells you how close you are.

legend.yellow_body: some values are shared, but not all of them.
legend.red_body: no match. An arrow means the answer's value is higher or lower.

columns.type: Type: the card's type (Hero, Weapon, Action, …).
columns.class: Class: the class(es) the card belongs to, if any.
columns.talent: Talent: the talent(s) the card belongs to, if any.
columns.pitch: Pitch: the pitch value(s) printed on the card.
columns.cost: Cost: the resource cost to play the card.
columns.power: Power: the card's printed power, if it has one.
columns.defense: Defense: the card's printed defense, if it has one.
columns.life: Life / Int: a Hero or Ally's life total.
columns.subtypes: Subtypes: the card's subtypes (Attack, Arrow, Trap, …).
columns.keywords: Keywords: functional keywords on the card (Go again, Dominate, …).
columns.set: Set: every set the card has been printed in.

set_tile.title: The Set Tile
set_tile.body: The Set tile turns green when your guess shares at least one set with the answer. Each set on the tile also gets its own mark:
set_tile.check: The answer was also printed in this set
set_tile.arrow_up: The answer comes from a later set
set_tile.arrow_down: The answer comes from an earlier set
set_tile.promo: Promo printings don't get a mark

rainbow.title: Rainbow Cards
rainbow.body_1: Some cards are printed in red, yellow and blue, and their numbers can differ per colour.
rainbow.body_2: Yellow on a Pitch, Power or Defense tile means your guess matches some of the answer's colours, but not all of them. An arrow only appears when every colour of the answer is higher or lower than your guess.
rainbow.example_number: Matches one of the answer's colours, not all of them
rainbow.example_pitch_partial: The answer has more colours than this

not_included.title: Which Cards Are Left Out
not_included.body: Fabble only draws from real, deckable cards. Tokens, markers, card backs and non-deck pieces (mentors, resources, blocks, macros, companions and demi-heroes) are left out, along with Marvels. Banned cards are still fair game as guesses in every mode; they simply never turn up as the answer in Standard.
